question: For whom is the hidden knowledge of reality preserved according to this teaching?
premises: The knowledge of reality is described as hidden.
It is associated with one of good conduct.
A great-minded one is indicated in this context.
inference: Hidden knowledge of reality belongs to the one of good conduct and great understanding.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation between satācārasya and mahāmatiḥ is compressed
plain_english: For one of good conduct, the hidden knowledge of reality belongs to the great-minded.
